trans-unit.source: Set a default for which parts of a website address (URI) need to match for Bitwarden to suggest a login for autofill. This policy won't be enforced for owners and admins.

trans-unit.source: Get started with your vault
trans-unit.target: Kom i gång med valvet

trans-unit.source: Complete these steps to secure your personal data and get the most out of Bitwarden

trans-unit.source: Install the browser extension

trans-unit.source: Save time by importing data from another password manager. You can manually add items to your vault.
trans-unit.target: Spara tid genom att importera data från en annan lösenordshanterare. Du kan också lägga till objekt manuellt i valvet.

trans-unit.source: Pin the extension to your browser. It'll allow you to sign in faster and seamlessly save your passwords.
